## 5. Effect of the pipeline optimisation (iCE40 HX8K, 4 seeds)

| RTL version | Lanes | Fmax best (MHz) | Fmax median (MHz) | All seeds |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| v1 | 1 | 47.55 | 46.3 | 44.48 46.28 46.30 47.55 |
| v2 | 1 | 47.35 | 46.87 | 45.42 46.81 46.87 47.35 |
| v1 | 4 | 42.46 | 42.04 | 40.38 40.53 42.04 42.46 |
| v2 | 4 | 44.39 | 44.3 | 43.31 43.75 44.30 44.39 |

v1 = decode and bypass-compare inside the execute stage; v2 (final) = decode registered in stage F and bypass flags pre-computed one cycle early.
